fields.statement: At 66cd47b7 (fixer cycle 3): go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/workflow/... passes (TestPlanPrePushFix checks plan and plan-milestone open-pr/rebase on.fail -> prepush-triage running ship gate --failed with only on.pass prepush-fix; prepush-fix agent, max_visits 2, on.pass open-pr, prompt says commit). rhiza workflow describe plan (and plan-milestone) lists prepush-triage and prepush-fix. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestShipGate passes (TestShipGateFailed: no kept head after a conflict exits 1; TestShipGateFailedOnPrePushFailure: a gh/push error records nothing and exits 1, the recorded pre-push head passes). make self-check now runs go test ./internal/workflow -run ^TestRepoWorkflowsPrePushFix$ first (seen in its output); in a scratch worktree at HEAD after rhiza render, make self-check exits 0 (in the run checkout it fails only on stale .rhiza/rendered actor files and index.md from this run's records, which render-pr fixes). Mutation check: a .rhiza/workflows/plan.toml copy of the built-in with open-pr's on.fail removed fails TestRepoWorkflowsPrePushFix (repo plan open-pr on.fail = ""; want prepush-triage), and an unchanged copy passes; main has no repo plan/plan-milestone copies today. The leaf's acceptance in the model was extended to name this guard, as decision prepush-fix-reaches-repo-workflows asks.
